import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    dim_emp_hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"].copy()
    asof_queries = inputs["asof_queries"].copy()
    
    # Perform the point-in-time join
    # For each query, find the version record where:
    # - emp_id matches
    # - as_of_date >= eff_start_date (start inclusive)
    # - eff_end_date IS NULL OR as_of_date < eff_end_date (end exclusive)
    
    # Merge on emp_id first
    merged = asof_queries.merge(dim_emp_hist, on="emp_id", how="inner")
    
    # Apply the date range filter
    # Start date filter: as_of_date >= eff_start_date
    start_condition = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    
    # End date filter: eff_end_date IS NULL OR as_of_date < eff_end_date
    end_condition = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])
    
    # Apply both conditions
    result = merged[start_condition & end_condition]
    
    # Select only the required output columns
    asof_result = result[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].copy()
    
    # Reset index to clean up after filtering
    asof_result = asof_result.reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"asof_result": asof_result}
